text:
Japan's real, PPP-adjusted GDP per capita rose roughly 12- to 13-fold between 1950 and 2016. By Maddison Project estimates in 2011 international dollars, it went from about $3,000 in 1950 to about $38,000 in 2016. The team note's $8,000 starting figure for 1950 looks too high, since Japan only reached that level in the early 1960s. The 2016 figure of about $40,000 is close to mine, but a "modest" rise doesn't fit the data. I'm working from memory and haven't checked the dataset.

CONFIDENCE: 78
